moments.onlyRace: Overtakes and battles only in races and sprints: in practice and qualifying each driver runs on their own and there is no on-track order to compare lap by lap. Below, the neutralisations and notable race control messages, which the player's moment buttons also jump between.
moments.noLaps: No data: this session has no timed laps.
moments.basis: An overtake is a change in the official order at the finish line between two consecutive laps of both cars, with neither entering or leaving the pits on those laps and less than 30 s apart. If either car lacks the line crossing of one of those laps, no overtake is claimed there. Passing and being re-passed within the same lap cannot be seen.
moments.lap1: Lap 1 does not count: there is no earlier official order (the grid is not in the data).
moments.pick: Click one to go 5 s before it.

pickWho.both: For an overtake, the overtaking driver is selected; for a battle, the chasing driver, compared with the one ahead.
pickWho.duel: The chasing driver is selected, compared with the one ahead.

overtakes.title: Overtakes
overtakes.atNoDataLong: jumps to the start of the lap
overtakes.approx: The overtake is confirmed by the finish line; the time (≈) comes from both cars' GPS positions within that lap.
overtakes.none: No overtakes confirmed at the finish line.
overtakes.nothingYet: No overtakes confirmed up to this moment yet. Move the player forward or turn off «No spoilers».

duels.title: Battles within 1 s
duels.basis: Two cars one after the other at the line, less than 1 s apart, for 3 laps or more, with no pit stops or SC, VSC or red flag on those laps (gaps shrink under neutralisation).
duels.none: No battles of 3 laps or more within 1 s.
duels.nothingYet: No battles up to this moment yet. Move the player forward or turn off «No spoilers».
duels.noTrackStatus: No per-lap track status data: laps under SC or VSC cannot be ruled out, so no battles are searched for.

basis.all: The start of each SC, VSC or red flag and notable race control messages: green light, chequered flag, double yellow, stopped or spun car, incident, penalty or black flag (several of the same kind less than 30 s apart count as one; the first is shown). The text is the original, in English; the time is the player's clock.
basis.neutralisation: The start of each SC, VSC or red flag, with the time on the player's clock.
basis.raceControl: Notable race control messages: green light, chequered flag, double yellow, stopped or spun car, incident, penalty or black flag (several of the same kind less than 30 s apart count as one; the first is shown). The text is the original, in English; the time is the player's clock.

others.none: No neutralisations or notable race control messages in this session.
others.nothingYet: None up to this moment yet. Move the player forward or turn off «No spoilers».

jump.filterHint: Choose which moments this tab shows and which ones the player's «Previous moment» and «Next moment» buttons (and the comma and full stop keys) jump between, landing 5 s before: overtakes, battle starts, neutralisations (SC, VSC or red flag) and notable race control messages (green light, chequered flag, double yellow, stopped or spun car, incident, penalty or black flag). With a single kind chosen, the player shows it next to those buttons.
jump.onlyTitle: The moment buttons only jump between {kind}. Choose in the analysis sheet's «Moments» tab.

lane.title: Overtakes confirmed at the line: {n}. The time of each mark is approximate (GPS).
lane.titleSoFar: Overtakes confirmed so far («No spoilers»): {n}. The time of each mark is approximate (GPS).
lane.tickNoData: L{lap}: {passer} passes {passed} (exact moment: no data; marked at the start of the lap)

cmd.onlyRace: Races and sprints only: in practice and qualifying there is no on-track order to compare lap by lap

overtake.none: No data: no overtakes confirmed at the finish line in this session (lap 1 does not count)
overtake.noneCar: No data: no overtakes involving {driver} confirmed at the finish line in this session (lap 1 does not count)
overtake.nonePair: No data: no overtakes between {a} and {b} confirmed at the finish line in this session (lap 1 does not count)
overtake.detailNoTime: L{lap}: {passer} passes {passed} · exact moment: no data, start of the lap (clock {clock}) · selects {select}
overtake.hidden: L{lap} (≈ clock {clock}) · no spoilers: who, once you get there
overtake.hiddenNoTime: L{lap} · exact moment: no data, start of the lap (clock {clock}) · no spoilers: who, once you get there

duel.none: No data: no battles of 3 laps or more within 1 s in this session
duel.noneCar: No data: no battles of 3 laps or more within 1 s involving {driver} in this session
duel.nonePair: No data: no battles of 3 laps or more within 1 s between {a} and {b} in this session
duel.noTrackStatus: No per-lap track status data: laps under SC or VSC cannot be ruled out, so no battles are searched for
duel.detail: From L{lap}: {chaser} behind {leader} within 1 s (clock {clock}) · compares {select} with {rival}
duel.detailNoCompare: From L{lap}: {chaser} behind {leader} within 1 s (clock {clock}) · selects {select}
duel.hidden: From L{lap} (clock {clock}) · no spoilers: who, once you get there
